To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the cooling of the flux switching permanent magnet machines can be enhanced by using a rotor with a step skew and that the heat dissipation from the stator winding can be increased by employing heat pipes.
a flux switching permanent machine can be cooled by means of rotor skewing or heat pipe technology.

a flux switching permanent machine with a large clearance can be successfully cooled with ordinary rotor skewing and that the heat can be directly extracted from the phase winding by means of a passive heat pipe cooling technique.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the cooling performance of a flux switching permanent machine with a large clearance.
two alternative ways of machine cooling which can be applied to the flux switching permanent magnet machines with a large airgap.
two different ways to cool a small power machine.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presented cooling techniques can be applied to flux switching machines in general.
both cooling techniques are able to provide the required heat transfer from the machine to its surrounding environment.
the presented cooling techniques are suitable to be implemented in a large air gap flux switching permanent magnet motor for the needs of the special application.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the presented cooling concepts for the investigated machine type are able to provide a good thermal performance for the machine.
a machine cooling technique is presented which can be applied for the special application of a flux switching machine with a large gap.
the rotor skewing technique is the most effective way for the thermal heat extraction in the case of the flux switching permanent magnet machines with a large airgap.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the heat extraction from the stator can be significantly enhanced by using the heat pipes.
the heat generated in the stator can be extracted directly from the coil sides by employing heat pipes and thus, the machine cooling can be significantly improved.
the rotor skewing is not only a good option for the cooling purpose but also for the machine performance in terms of the cogging torque reduction.
